ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Networking Lab. This course teaches an understanding of networks and systems design through hands-on construction and experimentation with real-world implementations. Students will perform bi-weekly projects in building, analyzing, evaluating, and deploying the communication protocols and server software that make up widely used network infrastructures. This course complements introductory computer networking courses such as CS 438 to cover practical and experimental aspects of networking. Prerequisite: CS 241 (Systems Programming), or equivalent course on operating systems or networking. This section is for graduate students only.
